propositions: The eight-phrase _CONTEXT_LEN_HINTS tuple is duplicated byte-for-byte in failure.py:148-157 and sizing.py:316-329, creating a maintenance hazard where fixes to one silently leave the other stale.

sizing.is_context_limit_error must remain a def in plan_review/sizing.py because orchestrator.py binds it at import time and test_plan_review_prerequisites_model_log.py monkeypatches it by string name.
sizing.py should import _CONTEXT_LEN_HINTS from failure.py rather than maintain its own copy, introducing no import cycle since failure.py only imports rebar.llm.errors.
The eight-phrase conjunction must appear in exactly one file under src/rebar (failure.py), verified by grep and enforced by a new guard test that flags when a second copy is introduced.
_is_token_exhaustion in completion_failures.py is a deliberately different classifier that omits the bare 'context' substring and must remain unchanged to avoid false positives.

Five existing test suites (test_llm_failure_classifier.py, test_change_input_not_an_outage_43d4.py, test_plan_review.py, test_plan_review_prerequisites_model_log.py, test_llm_failure_matrix.py) must pass without assertion edits after the consolidation.
